facts.complete_units: SaveData_Value whole Value and register/compile definitions
facts.meaning: Registration validates symbol/block, constructs the complete Value first, and appends it. Duplicate IDs remain multiple registrations; compile loops in registration order, so every save callback runs and the later same-ID result overwrites the hash slot. unregister removes every matching registration.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: A failing constructor is not appended. A later save callback/validation failure prevents later callbacks and prevents save_to_file opening output; earlier callback side effects are not restored. Dynamic extra registration order remains external.

facts.meaning: A registration class check is Object.const_get(class_symbol) then is_a?, not nested object-graph validation. Save and load validate each object; load marks loaded only after its callback returns. valid?(hash) checks every registration including missing-key nil, whereas load_values uses a present key, otherwise its new-game proc when defined.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: No all-values preflight is performed by load_values. A later failure can leave earlier globals assigned and loaded flags true. Missing without new-game proc is skipped. A callback that mutates then raises is not marked loaded but its external mutation can remain. Unknown hash keys are not loaded by these loops.

facts.meaning: Default17 registration order is player, frame_count, game_system, pokemon_system, switches, variables, self_switches, game_screen, map_factory, game_player, global_metadata, map_metadata, bag, storage_system, essentials_version, game_version, stats. Exactly game_system, pokemon_system, essentials_version, game_version and stats are boot-loaded. Only stats is reset_on_new_game. map_factory has no new-game proc.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: This is the fixed built-in registration set before plugin overrides/additions; it is not the engine object-graph inventory. Constructor failures stop the sequential new-game/boot loop at their actual prefix.

facts.meaning: player saves/loads the Player object through $player; Player inherits Trainer party and initializes a Pokedex field. storage_system saves/loads $PokemonStorage as PokemonStorage. global_metadata uses $PokemonGlobal/PokemonGlobalMetadata, map_metadata uses $PokemonMap/PokemonMapMetadata, and bag uses $bag/PokemonBag. Party and Pokedex are not separate built-in top-level SaveData IDs.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: This local code passes complete top-level objects to Marshal rather than manually projecting Pokemon fields. Pokemon/Pokedex/PokemonStorage inner instance-variable schemas, alias/cycle behavior, plugins, and exact binary payloads are not received by this contribution.

facts.meaning: File reader takes the first Marshal object as-is if it is a Hash; otherwise it reads sequential objects into an array until EOF, then adapter uses each registration old-format selector and omits nil. read_from_file runs conversion only for nonempty adapted data and rewrites the same requested path in wb only if conversions return true. save_to_file builds the hash before opening its output in wb.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: There is no file transaction or rollback in these methods; a serialization failure after open can retain truncation/partial bytes. Class/inner-field validation is performed by later Value APIs, not by accepting the first Hash. All old creature conversions are a separate contribution.

facts.meaning: Boot chooses initialize_bootup_values versus load_bootup_values by adapted hash emptiness. start_new loads eligible new-game registrations, samples uptime, increments sessions, then creates the map factory and refreshes encounter/map state. Game.load loads eligible registrations first, then samples uptime/increments sessions, then loads/updates map and only finally assigns Scene_Map.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: A failed later map stage can leave player/storage/global assignments, loaded marks and session increment intact. New-game factory is established outside the map_factory registration because it has no new-game proc. Complete map/transfer/event runtime remains OPEN.

facts.meaning: Normal save validates arguments, writes safesave, increments save_count, writes magic number and samples stats last-saved time before compile/write. Only IOError and SystemCallError cause save_count decrement and false return.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: Type/InvalidValueError/other exceptions escape; prior safesave, magic/time writes are not generally undone. On handled file errors only save_count is decremented, not the entire state. A successful return proves only that local calls returned, not every inner creature field or later reload.

facts.meaning: Event.trigger passes positional arguments only when callback arity is greater than two and equals provided count; otherwise it passes first sender argument plus an array of remaining arguments. trigger2 always spreads supplied arguments. Duplicate + callbacks are suppressed by include?; set clears then adds one.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: Callback exception aborts later callbacks with earlier side effects retained; there is no transaction, cancel flag or rescue in these primitive definitions. This dispatch family must not be confused with NamedEvent.

facts.meaning: EventHandlers.add lazily creates a NamedEvent and assigns named callback; same key replaces that value. trigger looks up the actual event name and spreads caller arguments into each callback in stored hash order. Unknown event returns nil; remove/clear of absent event are safe navigation no-ops.
facts.premises_failure_cancel_partial_and_open: No sender or argument array is automatically injected. A caller giving a Pokemon object hands that object directly; callback mutation is visible to subsequent subscribers and to caller. def pbRemoveItem(permanent = true)
    @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
    @effects[PBEffects::Unburden]   = true if self.item && hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
    setInitialItem(nil) if permanent && self.item == self.initialItem
    self.item = nil
  end

  def pbConsumeItem(recoverable = true, symbiosis = true, belch = true)
    PBDebug.log("[Item consumed] #{pbThis} consumed its held #{itemName}")
    if recoverable
      setRecycleItem(@item_id)
      @effects[PBEffects::PickupItem] = @item_id
      @effects[PBEffects::PickupUse]  = @battle.nextPickupUse
    end
    setBelched if belch && self.item.is_berry?
    pbRemoveItem
    pbSymbiosis if symbiosis
  end

  def pbSymbiosis
    return if fainted?
    return if self.item
    @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
      next if b.opposes?(self)
      next if !b.hasActiveAbility?(:SYMBIOSIS)
      next if !b.item || b.unlosableItem?(b.item)
      next if unlosableItem?(b.item)
      @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(b)
      if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
        @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} shared its {2} with {3}!",
                                b.pbThis, b.itemName, pbThis(true)))
      else
        @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} let it share its {3} with {4}!",
                                b.pbThis, b.abilityName, b.itemName, pbThis(true)))
      end
      self.item = b.item
      b.item = nil
      b.effects[PBEffects::Unburden] = true if b.hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
      @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(b)
      pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
      break
    end
  end

def pbEndOfBattle
    oldDecision = @decision
    @decision = 4 if @decision == 1 && wildBattle? && @caughtPokemon.length > 0
    case oldDecision
    ##### WIN #####
    when 1
      PBDebug.log("")
      PBDebug.log_header("===== Player won =====")
      PBDebug.log("")
      if trainerBattle?
        @scene.pbTrainerBattleSuccess
        case @opponent.length
        when 1
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1}!", @opponent[0].full_name))
        when 2
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1} and {2}!", @opponent[0].full_name,
                                @opponent[1].full_name))
        when 3
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1}, {2} and {3}!", @opponent[0].full_name,
                                @opponent[1].full_name, @opponent[2].full_name))
        end
        @opponent.each_with_index do |trainer, i|
          @scene.pbShowOpponent(i)
          msg = trainer.lose_text
          msg = "..." if !msg || msg.empty?
          pbDisplayPaused(msg.gsub(/\\[Pp][Nn]/, pbPlayer.name))
        end
        PBDebug.log("")
      end
      # Gain money from winning a trainer battle, and from Pay Day
      pbGainMoney if @decision != 4
      # Hide remaining trainer
      @scene.pbShowOpponent(@opponent.length) if trainerBattle? && @caughtPokemon.length > 0
    ##### LOSE, DRAW #####
    when 2, 5
      PBDebug.log("")
      PBDebug.log_header("===== Player lost =====") if @decision == 2
      PBDebug.log_header("===== Player drew with opponent =====") if @decision == 5
      PBDebug.log("")
      if @internalBattle
        pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You have no more Pokémon that can fight!"))
        if trainerBattle?
          case @opponent.length
          when 1
            pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You lost against {1}!", @opponent[0].full_name))
          when 2
            pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You lost against {1} and {2}!",
                                  @opponent[0].full_name, @opponent[1].full_name))
          when 3
            pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You lost against {1}, {2} and {3}!",
                                  @opponent[0].full_name, @opponent[1].full_name, @opponent[2].full_name))
          end
        end
        # Lose money from losing a battle
        pbLoseMoney
        pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You blacked out!")) if !@canLose
      elsif @decision == 2   # Lost in a Battle Frontier battle
        if @opponent
          @opponent.each_with_index do |trainer, i|
            @scene.pbShowOpponent(i)
            msg = trainer.win_text
            msg = "..." if !msg || msg.empty?
            pbDisplayPaused(msg.gsub(/\\[Pp][Nn]/, pbPlayer.name))
          end
          PBDebug.log("")
        end
      end
    ##### CAUGHT WILD POKÉMON #####
    when 4
      PBDebug.log("")
      PBDebug.log_header("===== Pokémon caught =====")
      PBDebug.log("")
      @scene.pbWildBattleSuccess if !Settings::GAIN_EXP_FOR_CAPTURE
    end
    # Register captured Pokémon in the Pokédex, and store them
    pbRecordAndStoreCaughtPokemon
    # Collect Pay Day money in a wild battle that ended in a capture
    pbGainMoney if @decision == 4
    # Pass on Pokérus within the party
    if @internalBattle
      infected = []
      $player.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
        infected.push(i) if pkmn.pokerusStage == 1
      end
      infected.each do |idxParty|
        strain = $player.party[idxParty].pokerusStrain
        if idxParty > 0 && $player.party[idxParty - 1].pokerusStage == 0 && rand(3) == 0   # 33%
          $player.party[idxParty - 1].givePokerus(strain)
        end
        if idxParty < $player.party.length - 1 && $player.party[idxParty + 1].pokerusStage == 0 && rand(3) == 0   # 33%
          $player.party[idxParty + 1].givePokerus(strain)
        end
      end
    end
    # Clean up battle stuff
    @scene.pbEndBattle(@decision)
    @battlers.each do |b|
      next if !b
      pbCancelChoice(b.index)   # Restore unused items to Bag
      Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnSwitchOut(b.ability, b, true) if b.abilityActive?
    end
    pbParty(0).each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
      next if !pkmn
      @peer.pbOnLeavingBattle(self, pkmn, @usedInBattle[0][i], true)   # Reset form
      pkmn.item = @initialItems[0][i]
    end
    return @decision
  end

def pbLearnMove(idxParty, newMove)
    pkmn = pbParty(0)[idxParty]
    return if !pkmn
    pkmnName = pkmn.name
    battler = pbFindBattler(idxParty)
    moveName = GameData::Move.get(newMove).name
    # Pokémon already knows the move
    return if pkmn.hasMove?(newMove)
    # Pokémon has space for the new move; just learn it
    if pkmn.numMoves < Pokemon::MAX_MOVES
      pkmn.learn_move(newMove)
      pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} learned {2}!", pkmnName, moveName)) { pbSEPlay("Pkmn move learnt") }
      if battler
        battler.moves.push(Move.from_pokemon_move(self, pkmn.moves.last))
        battler.pbCheckFormOnMovesetChange
      end
      return
    end
    # Pokémon already knows the maximum number of moves; try to forget one to learn the new move
    pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} wants to learn {2}, but it already knows {3} moves.",
                          pkmnName, moveName, pkmn.numMoves.to_word))
    if pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Should {1} forget a move to learn {2}?", pkmnName, moveName))
      loop do
        forgetMove = @scene.pbForgetMove(pkmn, newMove)
        if forgetMove >= 0
          oldMoveName = pkmn.moves[forgetMove].name
          pkmn.moves[forgetMove] = Pokemon::Move.new(newMove)   # Replaces current/total PP

def after_battle(outcome, can_lose)
    $player.party.each do |pkmn|
      pkmn.statusCount = 0 if pkmn.status == :POISON   # Bad poison becomes regular
      pkmn.makeUnmega
      pkmn.makeUnprimal
    end
    if $PokemonGlobal.partner
      $player.heal_party
      $PokemonGlobal.partner[3].each do |pkmn|
        pkmn.heal
        pkmn.makeUnmega
        pkmn.makeUnprimal
      end
    end
    if [2, 5].include?(outcome) && can_lose   # if loss or draw
      $player.party.each { |pkmn| pkmn.heal }
      timer_start = System.uptime
      until System.uptime - timer_start >= 0.25
        Graphics.update
      end
    end
    EventHandlers.trigger(:on_end_battle, outcome, can_lose)
    $game_player.straighten
  end

def pbGainMoney
    return if !@internalBattle || !@moneyGain
    # Money rewarded from opposing trainers
    if trainerBattle?
      tMoney = 0
      @opponent.each_with_index do |t, i|
        tMoney += pbMaxLevelInTeam(1, i) * t.base_money
      end
      tMoney *= 2 if @field.effects[PBEffects::AmuletCoin]
      tMoney *= 2 if @field.effects[PBEffects::HappyHour]
      oldMoney = pbPlayer.money
      pbPlayer.money += tMoney
      moneyGained = pbPlayer.money - oldMoney
      if moneyGained > 0
        $stats.battle_money_gained += moneyGained
        pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You got ${1} for winning!", moneyGained.to_s_formatted))
      end
    end
    # Pick up money scattered by Pay Day
    if @field.effects[PBEffects::PayDay] > 0
      @field.effects[PBEffects::PayDay] *= 2 if @field.effects[PBEffects::AmuletCoin]
      @field.effects[PBEffects::PayDay] *= 2 if @field.effects[PBEffects::HappyHour]
      oldMoney = pbPlayer.money
      pbPlayer.money += @field.effects[PBEffects::PayDay]
      moneyGained = pbPlayer.money - oldMoney
      if moneyGained > 0
        $stats.battle_money_gained += moneyGained
        pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You picked up ${1}!", moneyGained.to_s_formatted))
      end
    end
  end

def pbEndOfBattle
    oldDecision = @decision
    @decision = 4 if @decision == 1 && wildBattle? && @caughtPokemon.length > 0
    case oldDecision
    ##### WIN #####
    when 1
      PBDebug.log("")
      PBDebug.log_header("===== Player won =====")
      PBDebug.log("")
      if trainerBattle?
        @scene.pbTrainerBattleSuccess
        case @opponent.length
        when 1
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1}!", @opponent[0].full_name))
        when 2
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1} and {2}!", @opponent[0].full_name,
                                @opponent[1].full_name))
        when 3
          pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("You defeated {1}, {2} and {3}!", @opponent[0].full_name,
                                @opponent[1].full_name, @opponent[2].full_name))
        end
        @opponent.each_with_index do |trainer, i|
          @scene.pbShowOpponent(i)
          msg = trainer.lose_text
          msg = "..." if !msg || msg.empty?
          pbDisplayPaused(msg.gsub(/\\[Pp][Nn]/, pbPlayer.name))
        end
        PBDebug.log("")
      end
      # Gain money from winning a trainer battle, and from Pay Day
      pbGainMoney if @decision != 4
      # Hide remaining trainer
      @scene.pbShowOpponent(@opponent.length) if trainerBattle? && @caughtPokemon.length > 0

# Register captured Pokémon in the Pokédex, and store them
    pbRecordAndStoreCaughtPokemon
    # Collect Pay Day money in a wild battle that ended in a capture
    pbGainMoney if @decision == 4
